As Pepsico (PEP) Stock Declined, Holder Signature Financial Management Has Cut Its Holding by $342,480; Apple (AAPL) Shareholder Guardian Capital LP Has Trimmed Holding
May 9, 2018 - By Maria Brooks
Signature Financial Management Inc decreased its stake in Pepsico Inc (PEP) by 43.67% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Signature Financial Management Inc sold 2,854 shares as the company’s stock declined 9.24% with the market. The hedge fund held 3,681 shares of the consumer non-durables company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $442,000, down from 6,535 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Signature Financial Management Inc who had been investing in Pepsico Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $137.23B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.47% or $1.44 $96.79. About 4.28 million shares traded. PepsiCo, Inc. (NYSE:PEP) has declined 3.75% downtrending. It has underperformed by 15.30% the S&P500.
Guardian Capital Lp decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 1.32% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC.
